definitionZh: -webkit-tap-highlight-color是一个非标准的CSS属性,它设置了在被调用时在链接中出现的亮点的颜色. 突出显示显示用户,他们的水龙头正在被成功识别,并表明他们正在利用的元素.
sourceDefinition: -webkit-tap-highlight-color is a non-standard CSS property that sets the color of the highlight that appears over a link while it's being tapped. The highlighting indicates to the user that their tap is being successfully recognized, and indicates which element they're tapping on.
